typography.body_font: Satoshi, Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, sans-serif
typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-[1.1]

spacing_and_layout.container_padding: px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24 py-16 md:py-24 lg:py-32

components.cards: Use 'Crystal Glass' style over the subtle background. bg-white/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/50 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-4 bg-[#114232] text-white font-semibold hover:bg-[#0a2e22] shadow-lg shadow-[#114232]/20 transition-all
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-8 py-4 bg-transparent border-2 border-[#114232] text-[#114232] font-semibold hover:bg-[#114232]/5 transition-all

components.bento_grid: Use for Aim/Vision/Mission and 'How it works'. Mix of col-span-1, col-span-2, and tall formats with generous internal padding (p-8 or p-10).

images.description: Faint Guilloche pattern. MUST be used as a fixed, full-page background layer with very low opacity (10-15%) to create a 'certificate/trust' vibe without saying 'money'. Layer a subtle CSS noise over it.
3D Gold/Amber Reward coin. Use in the Hero section floating elegantly, or as an accent in the 'What is PRC' section.
Abstract growth/glass visual. Use in the 'Performance Summary' or 'Redeem System' to add high-end visual flair.
Lifestyle shot of an Indian user with a phone. Use softly masked or in a glassmorphic container for the 'About Us' or 'How It Works' section.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements should translate-y-[-2px] with increased shadow. Use purely CSS for hover states.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Use framer-motion. Staggered fade-up (y: 20, opacity: 0 to 1) for lists/bento items. Implement a slow, continuous float animation for the hero coin.

icons_library: lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react (Prefer phosphor for duotone high-end look if you can install it, else lucide).
instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT RULE: The user explicitly hates the current purple/violet gradients. Do NOT use them anywhere. Stick strictly to the Organic & Earthy palette (Forest Green, Amber, Bone White).

UNIQUE BACKGROUND REQUIREMENT: Implement the 'trust_guilloche_bg' image fixed to the viewport with `opacity-10` or `opacity-15`, blended with `mix-blend-multiply` and a subtle CSS grain/noise layer. This fulfills the user's request for a 'unique idea' and gives an authoritative 'Google Safe' certificate vibe.
CONTENT STRICTNESS: Keep language strictly to 'rewards' and 'daily activity'. DO NOT use words like 'investment', 'ROI', 'yield', 'profit', or 'earnings'. Follow Google Safe guidelines.

SECTIONS REQUIRED: Hero, Trust Section (CIN + badges), About Us, Aim/Vision/Mission (Bento Grid), How It Works (Steps), What is PRC (₹1 per 10 PRC utility), Redeem System, Performance Summary, Redeem Options, Disclaimer, Terms Summary, Final Line, FAQ, Footer.
Ensure 'Crystal Glass' style (high blur, translucent white bg, soft white border) is used for cards overlaying the background pattern to create a deep, premium 2.5D effect.
Do not build a dark mode version as the user requested a distinct change from the dark-theme app.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over glass containers meets APCA contrast guidelines. Text should be dark (#1C1917).
accessibility_and_testing.data_testids: All buttons, form inputs, links, and accordion items MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
